info.title: Quartermaster AI + TrustRail API
info.summary: AI procurement for restaurants, with deterministic spend controls and PayPal sandbox payments.
info.description: Autonomous procurement secured by TrustRail. Amounts are integer minor units (cents). Sign in with `POST /auth/login` (or `/auth/signup`): the API sets an httpOnly session cookie. Every mutation requires the header `X-Requested-With: quartermaster`; routes marked idempotent also require an `Idempotency-Key`. Errors share one shape (`ApiError`) with a stable `code`.
